stem.text: The graphs show trends in four physical properties of elements in Period 3, excluding argon.
Which graph has electronegativity on the $y$-axis?

A.alt: Line graph against Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl: rises to Mg, flat to Al, sharp peak at Si, falls at P, then low through Cl.

B.alt: Line graph against Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl: falls steeply from Na, then more gradually to Cl.

C.alt: Line graph against Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl: generally rising from Na to Cl with dips at Al and at S.

D.alt: Line graph against Na, Mg, Al, Si, P, S, Cl: near-straight, steady rise from Na to Cl.
